    <div class="mh-lab" aria-label="Math, code and a live chart of gradient descent">
      <div class="mh-step">
        <div class="mh-step-label"><em class="s1">1</em>The math</div>
        <div class="mh-math"><span class="math display">\begin{aligned}\mathcal{L}(w,b)&=\tfrac{1}{n}\textstyle\sum_{i}\big(w x_i + b-y_i\big)^2\\ w&\leftarrow w-\eta\,\partial \mathcal{L}/\partial w\end{aligned}</span></div>
        <p class="mh-hint">Mean squared error, and one gradient step that moves the line downhill.</p>
        <a class="mh-mini-link" href="ml/algorithms/gradient-descent.html">Read: Gradient Descent, Visually Explained <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a>
        <span class="mh-arrow">→</span>
      </div>
      <div class="mh-step">
        <div class="mh-step-label"><em class="s2">2</em>The code</div>
<pre class="mh-code"><span class="k">import</span> numpy <span class="k">as</span> np

w, b, lr = <span class="n">0.0</span>, <span class="n">0.0</span>, <span class="n">0.05</span>
<span class="k">for</span> epoch <span class="k">in</span> <span class="f">range</span>(<span class="n">200</span>):
    err = (w * x + b) - y   <span class="c"># error</span>
    w -= lr * <span class="n">2</span> * np.<span class="f">mean</span>(err * x)
    b -= lr * <span class="n">2</span> * np.<span class="f">mean</span>(err)
<span class="c"># → w ≈ 1.53, b ≈ 0.77</span></pre>
        <span class="mh-arrow">→</span>
      </div>
      <div class="mh-step">
        <div class="mh-step-label"><em class="s3">3</em>The output, live <span class="mh-live">Live</span></div>
        <div data-mh-lab></div>
      </div>
